description: Source file implementing the UpnpDiscoveryManager class, which manages UPnP device discovery, event handling, and device list updates in a system using IARM bus communication.

classes.name: CUpnpDiscoveryManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing UPnP device discovery, event handling, and device list updates.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CUpnpDiscoveryManager.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Activates UPnP discovery, registers event handlers, and requests device list.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates UPnP discovery and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: register_deviceupdate_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be called when device updates occur.

methods.name: getDiscoveredDevices
methods.description: Returns the current list of discovered UPnP devices as a JsonObject.

methods.name: saveUpdatedDiscoveredDevices
methods.description: Updates the internal device list and triggers the device update callback.

methods.name: requestUpnpDeviceList
methods.description: Sends a broadcast event to request the current UPnP device list.

methods.name: monitorUpnpEvents
methods.description: Handles UPnP data update events, retrieves device info, and updates the device list.
